chunks: And bestowed on him his brother Aaron, a prophet, through Our benevolence.
ai.seo_question: Who was given to Moses as a brother and prophet through God's mercy?
ai.summary: In Surah Maryam, this verse underscores the divine bestowal of prophethood upon Aaron (Harun) as a companion to Moses (Musa), highlighting their unique familial and spiritual bond. Shia scholarship often views this pairing as a model of cooperative leadership (imamah), where Aaron’s role as a prophet and vizier complements Moses’ authority, reinforcing the concept of shared divine mandate within the family of prophets.
